title: Group By Length
statement: Implement `solve(words)`. Group words by length. Return a dict whose keys are decimal strings of the lengths, because JSON object keys are strings, and whose values are the words of that length in input order.
constraints: Keys are strings of the integer length
Keep input order inside each bucket
hints: A defaultdict(list) or setdefault appends each word.
Convert the length to a string when you build the result dict.
Do not sort the words inside a bucket.
editorial: defaultdict(list) removes the missing-key branch. The buckets still have to be ordinary lists in insertion order. String keys are a serialization detail of this judge: JSON cannot use integer keys, and the decimal spelling is the contract.
